scenario.topic: Agree on the seating layout for the new open-plan office

options.name: Clustered Pods Layout
options.upside: Encourages small group collaboration while maintaining personal space.
options.concern: Pods may limit visibility across the entire office.

options.name: Linear Desk Rows Layout
options.upside: Maximizes line of sight and simplifies movement through the office.
options.concern: Less informal interaction due to linear seating arrangement.

options.name: Mixed Zones Layout
options.upside: Balances focused work with casual collaboration spaces.
options.concern: Reduced number of dedicated desks may limit individual workspace.

options.name: Perimeter Seating Layout
options.upside: Provides clear central area for meetings and group activities.
options.concern: Desks along walls may reduce spontaneous interaction among team members.

shared_context: The team of 7 is deciding on a seating layout for their new open-plan office. The layout must accommodate individual workspaces, collaboration areas, and easy access to shared resources within a 100 square meter space.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager who values balance between focused work and collaboration.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the layout supports both individual productivity and casual teamwork.

A.reason_for: Encourages small group collaboration while maintaining personal space.
A.reason_against: Pods may limit visibility across the entire office.

B.reason_for: Maximizes line of sight and simplifies movement through the office.
B.reason_against: Less informal interaction due to linear seating arrangement.

C.reason_for: Balances focused work with casual collaboration spaces, fitting Maya's priorities.

D.reason_for: Provides clear central area for meetings and group activities.
D.reason_against: Desks along walls may reduce spontaneous interaction among team members.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software developer who prefers clear organization and easy navigation.
personas.private_goal: Maximize efficiency and clear sightlines in the workspace.

A.reason_for: Supports small group collaboration within pods.
A.reason_against: Pods may limit visibility and movement, which Liam dislikes.

B.reason_for: Maximizes line of sight and simplifies movement through the office.

C.reason_for: Offers mixed zones for collaboration and focus.
C.reason_against: Fewer desks may reduce workspace availability.

D.reason_for: Centralized shared resources and clear meeting space.
D.reason_against: Perimeter desks may reduce spontaneous interaction.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a UX designer who thrives in small collaborative groups but values personal space.
personas.private_goal: Create a workspace that fosters teamwork without sacrificing individual focus.

A.reason_for: Encourages small group collaboration while maintaining personal space.

B.reason_for: Good line of sight and movement.
B.reason_against: Linear seating reduces informal interaction, which Nina dislikes.

C.reason_for: Balances focused work with casual collaboration spaces.
C.reason_against: Reduced number of dedicated desks may limit workspace.

D.reason_against: Perimeter desks may reduce spontaneous interaction.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is an operations lead who values clear structure and easy access to resources.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the layout supports smooth workflow and resource accessibility.

B.reason_for: Maximizes line of sight and simplifies movement.

C.reason_for: Multiple small collaboration zones and centralized resources.
C.reason_against: Fewer desks may limit individual workspace.

D.reason_for: Centralized shared resources and clear meeting space.
D.reason_against: Desks along walls may reduce spontaneous interaction.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a marketing strategist who prefers flexible spaces for both solo and group work.
personas.private_goal: Create a versatile environment that supports creativity and teamwork.

B.reason_for: Good line of sight and movement.

C.reason_for: Balances focused work with casual collaboration spaces.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a senior analyst who values clear structure and quiet individual workspaces.
personas.private_goal: Ensure the office layout supports concentration and easy access to resources.

A.reason_against: Pods limit visibility and may disrupt quiet work.

B.reason_for: Good line of sight and movement.

C.reason_for: Casual collaboration zones and centralized resources.

D.reason_for: Clear central area and perimeter desks support quiet work and easy resource access.

personas.name: Tara
personas.background: Tara is a content writer who prefers a calm environment with easy access to shared tools.
personas.private_goal: Have a workspace that minimizes distractions and fosters occasional collaboration.

A.reason_against: Pods limit visibility and may increase distractions.

B.reason_for: Maximizes line of sight and movement.

C.reason_for: Multiple small collaboration zones and centralized resources.
C.reason_against: Fewer desks may limit individual workspace.

D.reason_for: Central open space and perimeter desks provide calm individual workspaces and resource access.
